title: Restore Relay Dependencies
story: Convoy phase one. Power, radio and launch services must start in dependency order.
lesson: Topological sorting repeatedly chooses a node with no remaining prerequisites. A cycle leaves no eligible node.
objective: Input maps each service to its prerequisite list. Return lexicographically smallest available service at each step, or [] if cyclic. All prerequisites are named services.
hint: Keep a completed set. Sort the services whose prerequisites are all completed.
